newsitem.title: USA: Brent crude ends shade higher in US paper trading.
newsitem.headline: Brent crude ends shade higher in US paper trading.

text.p: Brent crude oil ended a shade higher in late U.S. paper trading on Monday, traders said.
Two full boats of August Brent changed hands at $18.27 and $18.22 a barrel, up from the IPE close of $18.20.
August Brent went out around $18.23-27, while exchange-for-physicals were pegged at $18.17-20, traders said.
August/September Brent traded once at a steady minus 12 cents, while September/October was pegged around minus 14/11 cents a barrel.
